Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) can cause severe respiratory #infections , especially in children & the elderly. Dr. Sandeep K. Shrivastava from Dr. B. Lal Clinical Lab highlights symptoms like #cough , fever & shortness of #breath . Early diagnosis & hygiene are key!
